title: Crown of the Canopy King
description: You find a crown made of twigs atop a tree. Wearing it fills you with confidence and a sudden knowledge of bird calls.

title: The Lantern at Journey’s End
description: After a long winding trail, a golden lantern waits for you. When lit, it reveals hidden memories and future paths.

title: Champion of the Cheese Festival
description: You win a cheese-stacking contest with flair. The prize? A golden wedge and lifelong bragging rights.

title: The Bell Beneath the Waterfall
description: You ring a hidden bell behind the falls. It echoes through the forest—and leaves a treasure chest at your feet.

title: Wisdom of the Moon Snail
description: A glowing snail circles you three times. You suddenly understand ancient forest riddles and the value of naps.

title: The Gem of the Forgotten Foxhole
description: You follow faint pawprints into a secret den. A glittering gem and a warm cup of something delicious await.

title: Feast of the Forest Spirits
description: You’re invited to a glowing feast deep in the woods. Every bite makes your senses sharper and your memories brighter.

title: The Pine Light Trials
description: You light a path using only fallen pinecones. At the end: a scroll, a charm, and the forest’s respect.

title: The Thunder Acorn
description: You catch a thunder-charged acorn mid-storm. It hums in your pocket and sparks a new kind of strength in you.

title: The Final Leap
description: You leap across a canyon with a roar in your heart. The landing leaves you sore—and richer in both coin and courage.

title: Echoes of the Elder Grove
description: Whispers lead you through the ancient trees. You emerge with bark-shaped tokens and knowledge older than time.
